stories.title: Mexico captures cartel leader listed as one of top 10 most wanted in US
stories.summary: Mexican forces captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as “El Chapo Isidro,” during an overnight operation in Sinaloa that triggered a fierce gun battle. Reports say seven alleged cartel gunmen and four soldiers were killed, while trucks burned and gunfire spread through the area. Meza Flores, an FBI Ten Most Wanted fugitive and leader of a Beltrán Leyva faction, was arrested with lieutenant Germán Rolando Gálvez Meza and taken to Mexico City; Mexican officials said U.S. intelligence aided the operation.

stories.title: ‘The doom of humanity’: will the quest to make robotic hands render us obsolete?
stories.summary: Engineers are racing to reproduce the dexterity of human hands, a longstanding obstacle to robots taking over a wider range of jobs. The Guardian examines that effort against the backdrop of warehouse automation, including digitally coordinated shelving systems at a large Amazon facility near Luton.

stories.title: Australian music industry rejects ‘divide and conquer’ proposal to give musicians exemption from AI scraping
stories.summary: Australia’s music industry has rejected a reported proposal to exempt musicians from AI scraping while leaving other creative sectors outside the deal. The head of Aria called that special treatment unworkable, and the industry said it would not accept a carveout that divided creators.
